actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (5d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 27). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained and the tarrasque can't bite a different creature.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d8 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d10 + 10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature  it falls prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The tarrasque makes a bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits  the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the tarrasque, it is blinded and restrained and it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage and 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the tarrasques turns. If a swallowed creature deals 70 or more damage to the tarrasque in a single turn, or if the tarrasque dies, the tarrasque vomits up all swallowed creatures.

actions.name: Radiant Breath
actions.desc: The tarrasque exhales radiant energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 27 Constitution saving throw  taking 105 (30d6) radiant damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

legendaryActions.name: The tarrasque can take 3 legendary actions
legendaryActions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The tarrasque attacks with its claw or tail.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed.

legendaryActions.name: Roar
legendaryActions.desc: Each creature of the tarrasques choice within 120 feet makes a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is in line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it succeeds on a saving throw or the effect ends on it, it is immune to the tarrasques Roar for 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Elite Recovery
legendaryActions.desc: The tarrasque ends one negative effect currently affecting it. It can use this action as long as it has at least 1 hit point, even while unconscious or incapacitated.

legendaryActions.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The tarrasque makes a bite attack or uses Swallow.

legendaryActions.name: Inescapable Earth (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Each flying creature or object within 300 feet falls and its flying speed is reduced to 0 until the start of the tarrasques next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thug attacks twice with their brass knuckles.

actions.name: Brass Knuckles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  it is unconscious and stable.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 feet  one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Keen Sight
abilities.desc: The griffon has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

abilities.name: Storm Sight
abilities.desc: A thunderbirds vision is not limited by weather.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The griffon attacks once with its beak and once with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage  or 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage if the griffon started its turn at least 20 feet above the target  and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the griffon can't attack a different target with its talons.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.desc: The thunderbird exhales a blast of lightning at one target within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half the damage on a success.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.desc: The tiger has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage. If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

bonusActions.name: Opportune Bite
bonusActions.desc: The tiger makes a bite attack against a prone creature.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.desc: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The dragon turtles spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
- **3/Day Each:** Control Weather, Water Breathing, Zone of Truth

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
abilities.desc: If the dragon turtle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, the faint glow cast by its shell winks out. When the dragon turtle uses Retract, it gains one more use of this ability and its shell regains its luminescence.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 52 (7d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends  the dragon turtle can't bite a different creature  and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 46 (6d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals double damage against objects  vehicles  and constructs.

actions.name: Steam Breath
actions.desc: The dragon turtle exhales steam in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw  taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Claws
bonusActions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Retract
reactions.desc: When the dragon turtle takes 50 damage or more from a single attack or spell, it retracts its head and limbs into its shell. It immediately regains 20 hit points. While retracted, it is blinded; its Speed is 0; it can't take reactions; it has advantage on saving throws; attacks against it have disadvantage; and it has resistance to all damage. The dragon turtle stays retracted until the beginning of its next turn.

reactions.name: Tail
reactions.desc: When the dragon turtle is hit by an opportunity attack, it makes a tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: The dragon turtle can take 3 legendary actions
legendaryActions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Kick
legendaryActions.desc: The dragon turtle makes a claws attack and then moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Emerald Radiance
legendaryActions.desc: Searing green light emanates from the dragon turtle. Each creature within 90 feet makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success. A creature that fails the saving throw is blinded until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Lightning Storm
legendaryActions.desc: The dragon turtle recharges and uses Lightning Storm.

legendaryActions.name: Tail (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The dragon turtle makes a tail attack.

name: Titanic Kraken
languages: understands Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

abilities.name: Bloodied Ichor
abilities.desc: While the Kraken is bloodied and in the water, black ichor leaks from it in a 60-foot radius, spreading around corners but not leaving the water. The area is lightly obscured to all creatures except the Kraken. A creature that starts its turn in the area takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

abilities.name: Immortal Nature
abilities.desc: The kraken doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.desc: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it can use its reaction, if available, to attack with its tentacle.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The kraken has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature grappled by the kraken  the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained  its Speed is 0  it has total cover from attacks from outside the kraken  and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the krakens turns.

actions.name: If a swallowed creature deals 50 or more damage to the kraken in a single turn, or if the kraken dies, the kraken vomits up the creature
Ink Cloud
actions.desc: While underwater  the kraken exudes a cloud of ink in a 90-foot-radius sphere. The ink extends around corners  and the area is heavily obscured until the end of the krakens next turn or until a strong current dissipates the cloud. Each non-kraken creature in the area when the cloud appears makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it takes 27 (5d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success  it takes half damage. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Summon Storm
actions.desc: Over the next 10 minutes  storm clouds magically gather. At the end of 10 minutes  a storm rages for 1 hour in a 5-mile radius.

actions.name: Lightning
actions.desc: If the kraken is outside and the weather is stormy  three lightning bolts crack down from the sky  each of which strikes a different target within 120 feet of the kraken. A target makes a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage or half damage on a save.

legendaryActions.name: The kraken can take 3 legendary actions
legendaryActions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle
legendaryActions.desc: The kraken makes one tentacle attack.

legendaryActions.name: Fling
legendaryActions.desc: The kraken uses Fling.

legendaryActions.name: Squeeze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The kraken ends any magical effect that is restraining it or reducing its movement and then swims up to half its swim speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, it can fit through gaps as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: False Appearance
abilities.desc: While motionless, the treant is indistinguishable from a tree.

abilities.name: Flammable
abilities.desc: If the treant takes fire damage, it catches fire, taking 10 (3d6) ongoing fire damage, unless it is already on fire. It can use an action to extinguish itself, ending the ongoing damage.

abilities.name: Forest Speaker
abilities.desc: The treant can communicate with beasts and plants.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.desc: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The treant makes two attacks  or makes one attack and uses Animate Plant.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Animate Plant
actions.desc: The treant magically animates a Large or larger plant within 60 feet. The plant is immobile  but it acts on the treants initiative and can make slam attacks  or rock attacks if there are rocks to throw within 10 feet of it. Non-plant creatures treat the ground within 15 feet of the plant as difficult terrain  as surrounding roots conspire to trip and grasp moving creatures. The plant remains animated for 1 hour. If the treant uses this action while it has three plants animated in this way  the plant that has been animated the longest returns to normal.

actions.name: Defensive Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage  and the target has disadvantage on the next attack it makes against the triceratops before the end of the triceratopss next turn.

actions.name: Trample
actions.desc: The triceratops moves up to its speed in a straight line. It can move through the spaces of Large and smaller creatures. Each of these creatures makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a failure.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The priest is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13 +5to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips** (at will): Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy, Minor Illusion
- **1st-Level** (4 slots): Ceremony, Detect Evil and Good, Healing Word, Disguise Self
- **2nd-Level** (3 slots): Lesser Restoration, Invisibility
- **3rd-Level** (2 slots): Spirit Guardians, Major Image

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.desc: (Cantrip; V, S) One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) The priest or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the invisible creature attacks or casts a spell.

actions.name: Spirit Guardians
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) Spectral forms surround the priest in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes. The priest can choose creatures they can see to be unaffected by the spell. Other creatures treat the area as difficult terrain  and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there  it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) radiant or necrotic damage (priests choice) on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Healing Word
bonusActions.desc: (1st-Level; V) The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.desc: A non-troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to a troglodytes Stench for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Perception checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troglodyte attacks with its bite and its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is infected with Troglodyte Stench.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

abilities.name: 1-4: Arm
abilities.desc: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

abilities.name: 5-6: Head
abilities.desc: If the troll has a head, it loses its head. It loses its bite attack, and the severed head can make a bite attack.

abilities.name: Keen Smell
abilities.desc: The troll has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.desc: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

abilities.name: Severed Limbs
abilities.desc: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll attacks with its bite and twice with its claw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tyrannosaurus makes a bite attack and a tail attack against two different targets.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends  the tyrannosaurus can't bite a different creature and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Good
abilities.desc: The unicorn radiates a Good aura.

abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
abilities.desc:
The unicorns innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** Animal Messenger, Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft, Pass Without Trace, Scrying (locations within its domain only),
- **1/Day:**  Calm Emotions, dispel evil and good, Teleport (between locations within its domain only)

actions.name: Healing: The creature magically regains 21 (6d6) hit points
actions.desc: It is cured of all diseases  and poisons affecting it are neutralized.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The unicorn attacks once with its hooves and once with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is a creature and the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Grant Boon
actions.desc: The unicorn touches a willing creature  including itself  with its horn and grants one of the following boons:

actions.name: Luck: During the next 24 hours, the creature can roll a d12 and add the result to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw after seeing the result
Protection: A glowing mote of light orbits the creatures head
actions.desc: The mote lasts 24 hours. When the creature fails a saving throw  it can use its reaction to expend the mote and succeed on the saving throw.

actions.name: Resolution: The creature is immune to being charmed or frightened for 24 hours

name: Ur-Otyugh
languages: telepathy 120 ft. (can transmit but not receive thoughts and images)

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
abilities.desc: If the ur-otyugh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it becomes more sluggish. Each time the ur-otyugh uses Legendary Resistance, its Speed and swim speed decrease by 10 and it loses one of its legendary actions on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: The otyugh slams any creatures it is grappling into a hard surface or into each other. Each creature makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  is stunned until the end of the otyughs next turn  and is pulled up to 5 feet towards the otyugh. On a success  the target takes half damage.

bonusActions.name: Bite
bonusActions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts a disease. While diseased, the target is poisoned. The target repeats the saving throw every 24 hours, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure (to a minimum of 1 hit point) and becoming cured on a success. The reduction in hit points lasts until the disease is cured.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.desc: If the otyugh has no other creature in its stomach, the otyugh bites a Medium or smaller creature that is stunned. On a hit, the creature is swallowed. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the otyugh, is blinded and restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the otyugh's turns. If a swallowed creature deals 15 or more damage to the otyugh in a single turn, or if the otyugh dies, the otyugh vomits up the creature.

legendaryActions.name: The ur-otyugh can take 2 legendary actions
legendaryActions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Mad Dash
legendaryActions.desc: The ur-otyugh moves up to half its Speed.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle
legendaryActions.desc: The ur-otyugh makes a tentacle attack. This attack has a range of 15 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Mental Fuzz (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The ur-otyugh transmits a burst of psionic static. Each non-aberration within 30 feet makes a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of the ur-otyughs next turn. On a success, the creature takes half damage.

name: Vampire
resistances: necrotic; damage from nonmagical, non-silvered weapons
languages: the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.desc: When the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it visibly grows older. Its original appearance is restored when it finishes a long rest.

abilities.name: Misty Recovery
abilities.desc: When the vampire drops to 0 hit points, instead of falling unconscious, it turns into mist as if it had used the Mist Form legendary action. It can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to vampire form and is paralyzed for 1 hour, at which time it regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this way, it can be destroyed by fire damage, radiant damage, damage from a magical weapon, or a wooden stake driven through the heart, but it is otherwise immune to damage.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and hasnt taken radiant damage since its last turn.

abilities.name: Resting Place
abilities.desc: Every vampires lair contains a resting place, usually a coffin or sarcophagus, where the vampire must rest for at least an hour each day to recuperate its powers. This resting place is sprinkled with soil from its mortal homeland. If this soil is scattered or is subjected to a Bless, Hallow, or similar spell, the vampire is destroyed when reduced to 0 hit points.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.desc: The vampire can climb even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

abilities.name: Vampire Weaknesses
abilities.desc: Vampires most common weaknesses are sunlight and running water. When the vampire ends its turn in contact with one of its weaknesses (such as being bathed in sunlight or running water), it takes 20 radiant damage. While in contact with its weakness, it can't use its Regeneration trait or its Mist Form or Shapechange actions.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: The vampire targets a creature within 30 feet  forcing it to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is charmed by the vampire for 24 hours. While charmed it regards the vampire as a trusted friend and is a willing target for the vampires bite. The target repeats the saving throw each time it takes damage  ending the effect on itself on a success. If the targets saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it  it is immune to this vampires Charm for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Bite
bonusActions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target that is grappled, incapacitated, restrained, willing, or unaware of the vampires presence. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The targets hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt, and the vampire regains this number of hit points. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points by this attack, it dies and rises the following night as a vampire spawn in the vampires thrall. Before the target first rises as a vampire spawn, a bless, gentle repose, or similar spell cast on the body prevents this transformation.

reactions.name: Hissing Scuttle
reactions.desc: When the vampire takes radiant damage, it moves up to its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Warding Charm
reactions.desc: When a creature the vampire can see targets it with a melee attack but before the attack is made, the vampire uses Charm on that creature.

legendaryActions.name: The vampire can take 1 legendary action
legendaryActions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendaryActions.name: Blood Charm
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire uses Charm. A creature makes its initial saving throw with disadvantage if the vampire has hit it with a bite attack within the last 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Grab
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire makes a grab attack.

legendaryActions.name: Mist Form
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire transforms into a mist or back into its true form. As mist, the vampire has a flying speed of 30, can't speak, can't take actions or manipulate objects, is immune to nonmagical damage from weapons, and has advantage on saving throws and Stealth checks. It can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing but can't pass through water. Anything its carrying transforms with it.

legendaryActions.name: Shapechange
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire transforms into the shape of a Medium or smaller beast or back into its true form. While transformed, it has the beasts size and movement modes. It can't use reactions or legendary actions, and can't speak. Otherwise, it uses the vampires statistics. Anything its carrying transforms with it.

name: Vampire Assassin
resistances: necrotic; damage from nonmagical, non-silvered weapons
languages: the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Misty Stealth
abilities.desc: While in Mist Form in dim light or darkness, the vampire is invisible.
